title: Technician filter on the expanded technician charts
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in on the build under test as an Admin user. The Admin role holds every permission, including Reports. To use another role, first check Settings > Roles & Permissions > that role: the Reports permission must be on.
  2. Pick one workplace in the workplace selector at the right of the top bar (e.g. QA Testing).
  3. Use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. At least two technicians can clock time: Settings > Staff > open each staff member > Edit Staff Member, Clockable switched on, Active, enrolled in this workplace (e.g. Grace Sullivan and Nadia Petrov).
  5. Each of those technicians has clocked time on invoiced work order lines this month (the QA Testing workplace has this). If not, create one per technician:
    • Customers > New Customer, enter a name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Dash Customer") and save.
    • Work Orders > New Work Order, pick that customer and an asset (use Add in the dialog if the customer has no asset), then Create.
    • In the work order header set the service advisor (e.g. Marcus Halvorsen).
    • On the Lines tab click New Line and add a labor line with labor hours (e.g. 1.00) and a price (e.g. $250.00), and assign a technician to the line (e.g. Grace Sullivan).
    • Sign in as that technician in a second browser, clock in on that line, and clock out after a known time (e.g. 15 minutes, which is 0.25 hours). Sign out of the second browser.
    • Back as Admin: approve the line, complete the work order and click Review.
    • Open the Finance tab and click Create Invoice. The invoice is dated today. Close the payment dialog that opens.
    • Repeat with a second customer and the second technician (e.g. Nadia Petrov).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. On the Technician Efficiency tile, click View details.
  3. Read the filter button at the top right of the chart.
  4. Click the filter button and read the list.
  5. Untick every technician except two (e.g. keep Grace Sullivan and Nadia Petrov).
  6. Close the list and read the chart's legend and lines.
  7. Click View details on the Technician Utilization tile.
  8. Repeat the last four steps on the Technician Utilization chart.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Each of the two technician charts has a Technician filter, reading Technician: All technicians before you change it.
  • The list lets you tick more than one technician, and every technician starts ticked.
  • After keeping two technicians the chart reloads and shows only those two: the legend names only them and only two lines are drawn.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9580 (Story 8, Chart Filters); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 8. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) boards 06_TechEff_After and 07_TechUtil_After, used for on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R1: “The Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization charts each have a Technician filter.”
  • S8-R2: “The Technician filter lets the user select any number of technicians and defaults to all technicians selected.”
  • S8-R5: “When the user changes a chart filter, the chart reloads scoped to the selected technicians or advisor.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
